## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Norway recorded 2,470K actual service units in 2025, in line with 2024 (2,477K).

- Actual 2025 service units were in line with the plan (2,474K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +1.4% above the actual 2019 level (2,437K).
